title: Microsoft Exchange StreamWriterWrapper Exposed Dangerous Function Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Microsoft Exchange. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the StreamWriterWrapper class. The issue results from the exposure of a dangerous function. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.
